name: marq-toolbox
description: Everyday utilities for working with an AI agent at Marq: digest long output, confirm intent before acting, zoom out and reframe, and turn repeatable processes into skills.

interface.shortDescription: Everyday AI skills for every Marq employee
interface.longDescription: A general-purpose collection of AI skills for working with an agent at Marq: consolidate long output into a digest, confirm intent before acting, zoom out and reframe a problem, and turn repeatable processes into skills.
defaultPrompt: Use $tldr to consolidate what you just told me into a short numbered digest.
Use $confirm to restate what I'm trying to accomplish before doing anything.
Use $zoom-out to step back and reframe what we're doing before we go further.
